reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Arizona
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent
              before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
*/

% -----------------------
% Scenario (question) facts
% -----------------------

scenario_state(arizona).
scenario_year(2021).

% The question is about whether there is a statutory minimum number of days of lateness
% (for nonpayment) before a landlord may file an eviction (special detainer) action.
scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_days_late_to_file).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(arizona),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_days_late_to_file).

% -----------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic, statute_* / legal_* predicates)
% -----------------------

/* AZ Rev Stat  33-1368(B) (2021)
   If rent is unpaid when due and the tenant fails to pay rent within five days after written notice
   by the landlord of nonpayment and intention to terminate, the landlord may terminate by filing
   a special detainer action pursuant to  33-1377.
*/
statute_az_33_1368_b_nonpayment_notice_grace_days(arizona, 2021, 5).

/* AZ Rev Stat  33-1368(G) (2021)
   "days" means calendar days.
*/
statute_az_33_1368_g_days_mean_calendar_days(arizona, 2021).

/* Legal rule derived from  33-1368(B):
   Minimum days after WRITTEN NOTICE of nonpayment before landlord may file a special detainer
   for nonpayment is Days (calendar days per subsection (G)).
*/
legal_minimum_days_after_written_notice_before_filing_nonpayment_eviction(State, Year, Days) :-
    statute_az_33_1368_b_nonpayment_notice_grace_days(State, Year, Days),
    statute_az_33_1368_g_days_mean_calendar_days(State, Year),
    integer(Days),
    Days >= 0.

% -----------------------
% Reasoning applied to the scenario
% -----------------------

% In this Q&A, "law specifies a minimum number of days" means:
% there exists a determinate statutory minimum (in days) governing filing for nonpayment.
law_specifies_minimum_days_for_nonpayment_filing(State, Year, Days) :-
    legal_minimum_days_after_written_notice_before_filing_nonpayment_eviction(State, Year, Days).

scenario_law_specifies_minimum_days(Days) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    law_specifies_minimum_days_for_nonpayment_filing(State, Year, Days).

% -----------------------
% Final answer (must be yes/no, deterministic)
% -----------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_law_specifies_minimum_days(_Days),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
